name: Door County Cube Challenge 2024
information: Welcome to Door County's third WCA Competition! We hope to see you here this August! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [**WCA Competition Tutorial**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook groups: [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) and [**Minnesota Cubing Community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)
